highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 preview 1 introduces Graphite, async pixel readback, and the Skia m152 engine.
highlights_body: The preview also expands Vulkan integration, adds Nano Server font support, fixes native lifetime hazards, and streamlines several managed and I/O hot paths.

bullets.detail: Moves the bundled renderer to Chrome milestone 152 after incorporating the final upstream stability updates from the m151 line.
Exposes Skia's next-generation GPU backend for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn.
SKImage and SKSurface can request pixel data asynchronously through a backend-neutral API.

bullets.lead: Native-backed pixel and region lifetimes corrected
bullets.detail: Keeps source objects alive while iterators, subsets, and transformed pixmaps use their native memory, and releases raster buffers when image creation fails.

bullets.lead: Managed and I/O hot paths streamlined
bullets.detail: Reduces repeated reflection, buffer copying, temporary strings, and uniform-map resizing in commonly used operations.
Adds a SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package for applications using Silk.NET's Vulkan bindings.
Uses FreeType so text rendering can discover and load fonts on Windows Nano Server.

contributor_summaries.jeffska: Added FreeType-based font support for Windows Nano Server
contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Added Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn

v4.152.0-preview.1.1.subtitle: Introduces the Graphite GPU backend, async pixel readback, and Skia milestone 152.
v4.152.0-preview.1.1.website_summary: Preview 1 introduces Graphite, async pixel readback, Nano Server font support, and Skia milestone 152.

bullets.text: Added Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn
Added backend-neutral async pixel readback for images and surfaces
Added FreeType-based font support for Nano Server
Updated the Skia engine to milestone 152
Corrected native lifetimes for region iteration and pixmap subsets, and released raster buffers after failed image creation
